description: Define and enforce the policy for selecting an outgoing like. Use a separate configurable daily like budget instead of consuming the reply budget. Exclude owned posts, posts already liked by AgentJido, duplicate local candidates, opted-out or blocked actors, stale candidates, and content that fails the participation safety rules. Apply an actor cooldown so repeated likes do not become spam. Acceptance: the decision model receives only eligible candidates; one selected like consumes one like budget unit only when acted or simulated; skips have stable reasons; restarts preserve the budget and prior selection memory; focused tests cover each exclusion and the budget boundary.
title: Add outgoing like eligibility and budget rules
